basic_info.description: Embrace coastal living year-round in this fabulous 3BD, 2.5BA ocean view condo, just 1 block from the beach in the coveted Outer Richmond neighborhood. Corner unit, approx. 1,600 sq ft of beautifully remodeled living space, sunlight through expansive windows, showcasing stunning views of the Pacific Ocean and breathtaking sunsets. The open-concept living and dining area, complete with a cozy fireplace and gleaming hardwood floors, provides the perfect setting for relaxation or entertaining. The bright kitchen features modern appliances, ample cabinetry, and a breakfast nook by the window. The serene primary suite offers a peaceful escape, where you can wake up to stunning ocean views and unwind in a tranquil setting overlooking the Greenbelt. Two additional bedrooms with ocean views, along with a full and half bathroom and multiple closets provide comfort. In-unit washer & dryer, an EV charging socket, 2-car parking, outdoor deck and low HOA dues. Explore Golden Gate Park & Ocean Beach for excellent surfing, coastal walks or hiking trails. Nearby, the iconic Sea Cliff, Balboa Village and Geary Blvd offer a rich array of shops and dining options. Public transportation, gym, cafes & Safeway across the street, convenience is at your doorstep. This is a beach lover's paradise!
